text:
maria-support: Customer reported promo rejected as "invalid/expired" when they try to redeem on billing page. Customer account: acct_8b9f, email masked. They pasted code SHIPTIME50 and get a UI toast: "Promo code invalid or expired". Screenshot attached by user.

olivia-eng: Can you paste the exact code string and repro steps? Also are they using SSO or invited via org?

maria-support: Code: SHIPTIME50. Steps: Settings > Billing > Apply promo > enter code > Apply. User signed up via self-serve (no partner). Tried on desktop Chrome and incognito. Same error.

jake-billing: Pinging promo-bot to check redemption logs + promo config.

promo-bot: SQL check for code SHIPTIME50 
```
select id, code, active, partner_only, start_date, end_date, max_redemptions, redemptions_count
from promo_codes
where code = 'SHIPTIME50';
```
Result: id=pc_2024_ship, code=SHIPTIME50, active=true, partner_only=true, start_date=2024-04-01, end_date=2024-12-31, max_redemptions=1000, redemptions_count=12

promo-bot: Latest API redemption attempt (most recent):
```
POST /v1/billing/apply_promo
{ "account_id":"acct_8b9f", "code":"SHIPTIME50" }
--> 400 { "error":"promocode_not_applicable", "reason":"partner_only" }
```

olivia-eng: Ah — config shows partner_only=true. That means promo only applies if account was created via partner onboarding or partner_id present on account. Customer self-serve so validation rejects with promocode_not_applicable.

maria-support: Did marketing intend this to be partner-only? The customer says they received the code in an email. Could be a partner forwarded the email.

jake-billing: Marketing confirms SHIPTIME50 was a partner campaign (partner: ShipWell) and the send accidentally included a couple of non-partner emails. We need to avoid changing promo rules without audit.

olivia-eng: For immediate remediation: we can (A) issue a manual billing credit to acct_8b9f for the promo amount, or (B) flip partner_only=false for this code (risky — will open to everyone). Recommendation: manual credit + fix marketing send.

maria-support: Customer asked for a credit or reissue. Can finance issue a one-time $50 credit? I'll draft the support reply.

finance-ops: Confirmed — we can issue a one-off invoice credit. Need account id, invoice id (if already billed) or we can create credit note to apply to next invoice. Please tag charge amount and reason.

maria-support: OK: acct_8b9f, request: apply $50 promo credit (SHIPTIME50 mis-sent partner code). No invoice yet — they were trying to redeem before billing. Requesting credit to be applied to next invoice.

jake-billing: I'll create a ticket to marketing to fix the campaign audience and to ops to add a verification step for partner_only codes. Also logging this for audit.

olivia-eng: Quick follow-up: add a unit test to validation that returns distinct error messages for partner_only vs expired so UI can show "code not valid for your account" instead of generic "invalid/expired". Filing eng task.

maria-support: Replying to customer now: 
"Sorry about that — looks like you received a partner-only promo by mistake. We will issue a $50 credit to your account and confirm when applied. Thanks for flagging." :pray:

finance-ops: Credit created: credit_77345 for $50, status: pending. Assigning to billing team to apply when next invoice generates.

jake-billing: Marketing ticket created (#MK-4097) — audience corrected, partner-only flag remains. Ops ticket (#OPS-2201) to add a pre-send validation for partner-only codes. Eng ticket (#ENG-778) for ui error clarity.

maria-support: Marking this thread resolved from support side once finance confirms credit applied. Will follow up if customer reports issue. :white_check_mark:
